trap.label: relato de mistério
trap.wrong: Could you tell me if did you notice it? I didn’t notice it was missing. The staff say that nothing disappear.
trap.right: Could you tell me if you noticed it? I didn't notice it was missing. The staff said that nothing had disappeared.
trap.why: Em português “perguntar se você percebeu” mantém a inversão. Em inglês, ordem afirmativa e tempo recuado ao relatar. O brasileiro também esquece o -ed de disappear.

mcq.q: Could you tell me if you ___?

fix.wrong: Do you know if did he see it?
fix.right: Do you know if he saw it?

fix.wrong: It was missing, I noticed not.
fix.right: I didn't notice it was missing.

fix.wrong: The guard tell that nothing happened.
fix.right: The guard said that nothing had happened.

rewrite.prompt: Torne polida: “Did you notice it?” (Could you tell me if...)
rewrite.answer: Could you tell me if you noticed it?

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no discurso indireto: Staff: “Nothing disappeared.” (said)
rewrite.answer: The staff said that nothing had disappeared.

rewrite.prompt: Torne negativa: “I noticed it was missing.”
rewrite.answer: I didn't notice it was missing.
